subject: Running Maaslin on altered Centrifuge output files

messages.author: 131eb6741b85163e
messages.subject: Running Maaslin on altered Centrifuge output files
parts:
Hi,

I'm attempting to run Maaslin (v0.0.5) in R (v3.4.4), using abundances calculated with Centrifuge. I believe I have formatted my files correctly so that Maaslin will read them, but I am getting the following error:

NAs introduced by coercionNAs introduced by coercionNAs introduced by coercionNAs introduced by coercion
Error in liItemElement[1]:liItemElement[2] : NA/NaN argument
My R command is as follows:
Maaslin('maaslin/gtdb_abundances/baseline/baseline_preAb_abundances_metadata_RCombined.txt', 'maaslin/gtdb_abundances/baseline/baseline_preAb_discrete_challengeSummary', strInputConfig='maaslin/gtdb_abundances/baseline/maaslin_config_baseline_preAb_challengeStatusSummary_RCombined_171218.config')
I've attached my config files and my abundance file (however just the first 1000 lines as the file is 50Mb and so can't be uploaded here), but as far as I can tell they are in the same format as the Maaslin ones? I initially had issues with non-allowed characters, but I have now removed all of those and the error persists.

Thanks,
Jane
